pr.title: [FIX] Translate marketplace trait filters
pr.body: # Pull request description ## Summary This PR localizes the Bud and Pet trait filters in the marketplace. Filter labels and options now use i18n keys instead of hardcoded English strings, while preserving existing filter values and URLs. ## Context / motivation Marketplace NFT filters remained in English when the game language was changed. This affects all filter groups and options under **Bud NFTs** and **Pets**, including traits, boosts, resources, levels, colours, and chapter collections. The new keys are organized by reusable domain (`bud.*`, `pet.*`, `chapter.name.*`, `filter.*`, and `colour.*`) and reuse existing resource translations where applicable. ## How to test 1. Start the game with `yarn dev` and open the Marketplace. 2. Open the sidebar filters and expand **Bud NFTs** and **Pets**. 3. Verify trait groups and options display translated labels after translations are generated from `dictionary.json`. 4. Select and clear several filters to confirm filtering behavior and URLs remain unchanged. 5. Open the chapter collection filter and verify chapter labels display correctly. ## Screenshots or screen recording The screenshots below are representative examples only. The localization was added for every previously hardcoded filter label and option in the **Bud NFTs** and **Pets** sidebar sections. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added locale-aware marketplace filter labels and grouping for Buds and Pets, including localized chapter names and trait/resource option text. * Updated localization to include Festival of Colors 2026 taxonomy labels a
